classification.difficultyReason: Convert the height and horizontal length to matching units, identify their tangent ratio, and use inverse tangent to obtain the ground angle.

inlines.text: A triangle skateboard ramp has a horizontal length of
Calculate the angle that it makes with the ground to the nearest minute.

spec.description: Unshaded triangular ramp with visible depth cues, a vertical left edge, horizontal front base, right-angle marker and acute interior angle theta at the right end. Editable height and base labelling regions sit beside and below the figure.
spec.mathematics: The front face is right-angled. Height is 80 cm. The stem supplies a length of 3.5 m without explicitly identifying its edge. Coordinates express topology and are not additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: No dimensions or calculated angle are supplied in the student diagram.

answer.worked:
Label the horizontal base $3.5\text{ m}$ and the height $80\text{ cm}=0.8\text{ m}$.
$$\begin{align*}\tan\theta&=\frac{0.8}{3.5}\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{0.8}{3.5}\right)\\\theta&\approx12.87500156^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx12^{\circ}53'\end{align*}$$
